unknown_encoding.boundary: start_boundary or end_boundary=unknown; corresponding tau and censor masks are zero only

coverage_mode.unknown: No presence positives or negatives may be inferred from this interval.
coverage_mode.positive_only: Only explicitly reviewed segment rows are positive; all unmatched queries remain unknown.
coverage_mode.exhaustive: The complete interval was reviewed; unmatched queries may be supervised as negatives.

coverage_csv.exhaustive_negative: An exhaustive coverage interval with no overlapping segment row. Never encode a fake negative segment row.

identity_rules: segment_id names one physical interval and is globally unique across the campaign.
onset_event_id is required iff the onset boundary is observed.
release_event_id is required iff the release boundary is observed.
Censored or unknown boundaries have no fabricated event ID.
Repeated sliding-window appearances retain one global segment_id.

boundary_mask_contract.observed_onset: If onset is inside the window, supervise its true start_tau and left_censored=0; if before the window, supervise start_tau=0 and left_censored=1.
boundary_mask_contract.observed_release: If release is inside the window, supervise its true end_tau and right_censored=0; if after the window, supervise end_tau=1 and right_censored=1.
boundary_mask_contract.coverage_censored_or_unknown_onset: Only current_frame > conservative confirmed-positive start proves onset is before the window; then supervise start_tau=0 and left_censored=1. Equality cannot distinguish onset at the boundary from onset before it, so equality and earlier windows mask both fields.
boundary_mask_contract.coverage_censored_or_unknown_release: Only real_window_end < conservative confirmed-positive end proves release is after the window; then supervise end_tau=1 and right_censored=1. Equality cannot distinguish release at the boundary from release after it, so equality and later-ending windows mask both fields.
boundary_mask_contract.field_level_rule: Masking unknown boundary fields never clears independently known presence/side/site/object_role/contact_mode.
boundary_mask_contract.left_censored: The physical onset is before the reviewed/window boundary.
boundary_mask_contract.right_censored: The physical release is after the reviewed/window boundary.

window_query_contract.assignment: query_index is the zero-based rank under the deterministic sort in that window
window_query_contract.overflow: Hard validation/build failure when more than 12 physical segments overlap one window; no silent truncation or overwrite.
